items.headline: No. 22 Liberty beats Western Kentucky 45-14 for its 10th consecutive win
items.description: — Deshawn Purdie threw for a season-high 344 yards and accounted for three touchdowns as No. 22 Liberty rolled past Western Kentucky 45-14 on Saturday for its 10th consecutive win.
